root_joint.reason: standard v2.0 sets bench_press.root_joint to weld (Repository_Management#2024); the bench-press generator still emits a free pelvis. Welding it at the v2.0 start via-pose root is a separate generator change.

phase_names.reason: standard v2.0 names the gait and sit-to-stand phases; these functional movements still use pack-local names. The five lifts consume the spec (LIFT-2, UpstreamDrift#11742).

coordinate.shoulder_*_adduct.limits_rad.reason: the vendored standard's shoulder_{side}_adduct limits_deg [-30, 180] mirror the anatomical abduction/adduction convention (positive = adduction toward the midline); this model uses the corrected [-180, 30] range (abduction to ~180 deg, adduction capped near 30 deg, Kapandji 2008). Tracked upstream as Repository_Management#2062; the standard itself is not edited here.
